transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, we're looking to issue $18 million in senior unsecured bonds to refinance existing debt and fund our approved environmental projects. The preliminary term sheet proposes a 3-year fixed-rate bond at a 5.50% coupon, settling September 15, 2026, with no sustainability label and no specified redemption protections. Before I can approve the final term sheet, I need to hear from each of you per our review policy. Let's go in order: sustainability, investor coverage, treasury, and legal. Who's ready to start?

I received this confirmation in a memo that hasn't yet been circulated to the rest of you. The preliminary term sheet currently has no sustainability label, which would put us out of compliance with our own framework if we intend to use these proceeds under it.
